_readme: Edit this file to change the register's menu. Commit it and the POS picks it up on the next load — no code change.
Every field is checked before use. A bad entry is dropped; if nothing survives, the register falls back to the menu built into the page, so it can never end up with no menu.
id     — letters, numbers, - and _ only. Must be unique. Changing an id is fine; it is not stored anywhere.
cat    — must match one of the category ids below, or the item will not show under any tab (it still shows under All).
price  — a number in dollars, 0 or more. This is what the customer is charged. Use 8 or 8.50, not "$8.50".
emoji  — shown when img is empty.
img    — optional image URL (https:// or /path). Leave as "" to use the emoji.
The Custom $ tile is built into the register and is not listed here.
